repos_data.description: Read and analyze SEC EDGAR filings in Python. 10-K, 8-K, XBRL financials, Form 3/4/5, 13F, ADV — clean API, well-typed, MIT-licensed.
Demo code for direct Black-Scholes implied-volatility calculation from normalized call prices via the inverse-Gaussian quantile representation.

This open-source, and convenient python tool is designed to calculate fair value of a stock for given revenue growth and free cash flow margin assumptions of a company. Users can run the tool in batch mode for multiple stock valuations in one go. Download the packaged application in the latest release!
MCP server for SECfinAPI — standardized SEC EDGAR financial data (income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, 40+ ratios) for Claude, Cursor and other AI assistants.
FinData MCP — Financial data via Model Context Protocol. Live market prices, SEC filings, earnings, options flow, macro indicators.

MCP server for the Filingrail SEC EDGAR API — company financials, insider trades, 8-K events, 13F holdings, and filings for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, and any MCP agent. pip install filingrail-mcp
An open-source alternative to Yahoo Finance's market data APIs with higher reliability.
Terminal ETF research & portfolio analytics via SEC EDGAR and IBKR
Wiseek Filing Impact Monthly — free citable statistics on how SEC filings move stocks (CC BY 4.0)
SEC/EDGAR financial filings API for AI agents — pay per query in USDC via x402
Free point-in-time US fundamentals sample (40 large caps, 3,280 rows) — every value stamped with the date it became public. No lookahead bias. From SEC EDGAR.

repo_meta_data.description: Invert a stock price into the bet it implies: the growth, duration, and margin a price assumes. Textbook expectations-investing reverse DCF over SEC EDGAR filings. No price targets, no ratings.
